summary: PDD Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the passing of independent director Dr. Ivonne M.C.M. Rietjens in August 2026 at age 67. Dr. Rietjens had served on the board since August 2023. The board expressed condolences and noted it will review committee composition as needed. This is a routine disclosure of a director's death, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate events are involved.
